title.narrative: Strengthening Water Security and Climate Resilience in West Africa under IHP-IX

description.narrative: West Africa faces growing water security challenges driven by climate variability and change, rapid population growth, urbanization, environmental degradation, and increasing pressure on water resources. Many countries in the region experience recurrent droughts, floods, erosion, and water scarcity, while significant gaps remain in water infrastructure, monitoring systems, and institutional capacities. The transboundary nature of many river basins and aquifers further underscores the need for strengthened regional cooperation and integrated approaches to water resources management. This workplan aims to support Member States in advancing water security, climate resilience, knowledge-based decision-making, inclusive governance, and transboundary cooperation
